name: bifrost-copilot-provider
description: Copilot Chat model provider for a self-hosted Bifrost LLM gateway, with automatic model and context-size discovery.

bifrost.baseUrl.description: Base URL of your Bifrost gateway, e.g. https://bifrost.example.com

bifrost.contextSizeOverrides.description: Some Bifrost providers (e.g. ollama, custom OpenAI-compatible providers) report no context-size metadata at all, so a conservative default is used instead. Use this to correct it. Keys can be an exact model id (e.g. "ollama/llama3.1") or a provider prefix (e.g. "ollama") used when no exact key matches. Values are the model's max input tokens.

bifrost.routingTargets.description: Workaround for Bifrost's weighted Routing Rules picking a target independently on every request, with no session affinity (see github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/5409) — this can break providers that track conversation state per key, e.g. DeepSeek thinking-mode continuity. When set, every request in a conversation is tagged with the same one of these labels (sent as the X-Bifrost-Route header), chosen deterministically so the same conversation always lands on the same label; the relative numbers set their weight. Configure one exact-match Header routing rule per label in Bifrost (condition: X-Bifrost-Route equals the label), each pointing at a different provider key, in place of a single weighted rule. Leave empty (the default) to send nothing and disable this.
